verdicts.reason: A breaks up the price cards: Yearly and Family sit side by side above the subhead, and Monthly is left alone further down. The order is wrong (48, 80, then 6), the cards are tiny with illegible labels, the logo is pushed right and the gaps are scattered. B keeps the three cards in one row, but they are tiny with unreadable labels, the order is wrong (6, 80, 48, so Yearly has moved to the end), and the legal text is placed above the cards and CTA as if it were content, with a large dead gap under the subhead.
